summary: Promotional credit vanished after hourly rate-lookup ambiguity during invoice consolidation
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that a promotional credit (one-time onboarding promo) reflected on the provisional hourly ledger on 2026-03-05 but is missing on the finalized consolidated invoice for the billing period ending 2026-03-08. Impact: Customer sees a $4,500 net increase on their finalized invoice and is requesting immediate correction and explanation. Environment: Production (us-east), customer on enterprise plan using Dedicated + hosted fallback; consolidated billing across 3 subaccounts.

Observed behavior:
- 2026-03-05 02:14 UTC: hourly postback contains a promo_credit tag for subaccount B (staging-tag present).
- 2026-03-05 02:15 UTC: consolidation job runs and merges subaccount ledgers to parent org.
- 2026-03-05 02:16–02:18 UTC: postback replays / worker retry inserts a second hourly record without promo_credit tag due to rate-lookup mismatch.
- Final invoice (generated 2026-03-08 04:00 UTC) shows no promo credit; provisional ledger contained the credit prior to consolidation.

Customer-stated impact: unexpected charge + urgent accounting review; needs a credit applied and root cause for audit.
steps_to_reproduce: Simulate hourly postback for multi-subaccount org with promo_credit tag present in initial request.
Trigger consolidation job (merge ledgers) immediately after initial postback.
Force postback worker retry that excludes promo_credit metadata (simulate missing tag TTL).
Finalize invoice and compare provisional hourly ledger vs final invoice lines.
logs_or_snippets: postback-worker/us-east PID=11234 INFO Received hourly-postback org=org-873 sub=acct-B credit_tag=promo_onboard_2026-03-01 ttl=120s
consolidation-runner/us-east INFO Merging ledgers parent=org-873 children=[acct-A,acct-B,acct-C] run_id=consolid-2026-03-05-0215
postback-worker/us-east PID=11234 WARN Retry: failed_fetch_metadata for postback_id=pb-998877; falling back to rate_lookup(existing=false)
billing-processor/us-east INFO FinalizeInvoice invoice=INV-2026-03-org-873 total=38450.00 credits_applied=0.00
investigation_notes: Initial triage (Support): confirmed provisional ledger contained promo credit line for acct-B (timestamp 2026-03-05T02:14:12Z).
SRE: observed race window between consolidation job and postback retry: consolidation reads ledger before retry inserts corrected line without promo metadata.

Billing-engine: hourly rate-lookup logic uses a two-step heuristic: prefer 'latest_tag' if present, otherwise fallback to stored rate profile. On retries where metadata payload is missing, heuristic returns false and promo_credit not applied.
Found that postback worker retry path strips transient metadata TTL when metadata-service returns 500; retries then call rate-lookup with existing=false.
Test repro in staging: reproduces when consolidation interval < postback retry delay.
comments: 2026-03-10 Emily Vargas: Acknowledged ticket — looping in billing-engine and SRE. Created INC-2026-873 to track temporary surge window. Requested provisional invoice export from accounting.
2026-03-10 Priya Mehta (Customer): We saw the provisional ledger showing the credit; final invoice removed it. Our finance team needs the corrected invoice by COB 2026-03-12 for reconciliation.

2026-03-11 Marcus Lee (SRE): Added logs showing consolidation start/end times. Consolidation started at 02:15:00Z and finished 02:15:40Z; retry postback arrived at 02:16:05Z. There's a 25s gap where a retry will append after consolidation.

2026-03-11 Anita Rao (Billing): Confirmed that invoices reference latest merged ledger snapshot; duplicates or later retries that omit promo tags will override previously-visible provisional credit during finalization.
root_cause_summary: Race between hourly consolidation job and a postback retry path that may omit transient promo metadata. When a retry without promo metadata arrives after consolidation, ledger merge semantics cause the later record to be authoritative and the promotional credit is dropped at invoice finalization.
resolution:
Short-term workaround: manually re-apply the promo credit to the finalized invoice and issue invoice adjustment for INV-2026-03-org-873 (credit $4,500). Applied credit on 2026-03-11 and sent adjusted invoice PDF to customer.
Long-term fix: patch committed to billing repo to make rate-lookup idempotent and prefer 'first-seen' promo tags for a 5-minute consolidation window; add metadata-service retry-withbackoff to preserve TTL; add consolidation pre-check to delay finalization if pending postback retries detected. Changes merged as PR #784; rollout to staging scheduled 2026-03-13, prod roll on 2026-03-18 behind feature flag.
Follow-ups: postmortem and runbook update assigned to @Anita Rao, follow-up ticket INT-5301 for consolidation window tuning.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-11 Emily Vargas: Manual credit issued, accounting adjusted invoice; customer notified and refunded $4,500 via credit memo CM-2026-1492.
2026-03-11 Priya Mehta (Customer): Confirmed receipt of adjusted invoice and credit memo; finance team satisfied. Thank you.
2026-03-12 Marcus Lee: Deployed monitoring alert (billing:postback-retry-after-consolidation) to catch similar race windows.
